subject: Greenline: Sync for compliance intake — compressed windows & team coverage

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@greenline.com>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenline security intake: SOC 2 / DPA / pentest kickoff

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this on — we'd like to schedule an intake covering three items: a SOC 2 scoped walkthrough, a DPA review (sig terms we've highlighted in the attached questionnaire), and an initial pen-test kickoff with our external vendor. We're aiming to keep this compact (90–120 minutes total) and prefer a compressed day where possible so engineers can stay in one block.

High-level:
- Audience: security ops, compliance manager, infra lead (we'll include Priya Sharma from security).
- Items to cover: control mapping, data flows, evidence sources, pen-test scope & timing.
- Preferred timezone windows: PST morning (10:00–12:30) or EST afternoon (14:00–16:30).

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week? Also let us know if Redwood prefers to split into two shorter sessions vs. one long block. I've attached our baseline questionnaire for your team to review.

Cheers,
Oliver Hayes
Security Operations Manager
Greenline Financial

Attachment: Greenline_Compliance_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Greenline security intake: SOC 2 / DPA / pentest kickoff

Hi Oliver —

Appreciate the context and the questionnaire. Happy to run a compact intake and keep it tight. Proposed options (all in PST):

1) Wed 2028-02-21, 10:00–12:00 (90–120 min; primary option)
2) Thu 2028-02-22, 11:00–13:00 (90 min)
3) Mon 2028-02-26, 09:30–11:00 (split if needed into two 45-min sessions)

Attendees from our side: Kimberly Park (Compliance), Mina Haddad (SecurityEngineer), Tessa Morgan (Customer Success) — I'm coordinating invites. If you expect the pen vendor to join for the full block, we can triage pen-specific alignment into a separate 30-min slot directly after the main intake (suggestion: vendor-only 30 min to agree on scope and rules of engagement).

We will also upload our preflight checklist and a read-only evidence bundle link ahead of the session so you can scan controls rather than walk every doc live. I'll attach a calendar file with the proposed slots and a short checklist PDF.

Let me know which option you pick and whether you want the vendor in the main block or in a separate alignment.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_slots.ics, Redwood_Preflight_Checklist.pdf

Also: our pen vendor (SecurePartners) prefers to do a vendor-only 30-min call the same day at 13:45 PST if that works. I'll loop in their penops alias once the time is locked.

- Can you pre-share a mapping of who on your team owns which evidence buckets? (e.g., access logs, backups, retention config)
- Do you have a preferred location for evidence transfer (we prefer a limited-access Drive folder or SFTP; Drive link is easiest).

On the questionnaire: we'll fill in the first tab and return before the call.
